headline-lg.purpose: Newsreader — page titles and major section headers.

headline-md.purpose: Newsreader — section headers within a page.

body-lg.purpose: Hanken Grotesk — lead paragraphs, descriptive copy. ~65–75ch.

body-md.purpose: Hanken Grotesk — default body, move lists, PGN, table cells.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single committed action style — sage ground, white text, soft radius. Use for the primary action on any surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 40px; padding: 0 1rem; background: var(--primary, #496458); color: var(--primary-foreground, #ffffff); font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; border-radius: 0.3rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #385246; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px hsl(28 28 25 / 0.06), 0 2px 4px hsl(28 28 25 / 0.04); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring, #496458), 0 0 0 6px hsl(153 16% 35% / 0.18); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Pill Button (signature CTA)
components.description: Fully-round sage CTA for hero actions. Wider padding than the default primary. Optionally pairs with an animated → glyph.
components.css: .ds-btn-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 44px; padding: 0 1.5rem; background: var(--primary, #496458); color: var(--primary-foreground, #ffffff); font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-pill:hover { background: #385246; box-shadow: 0 8px 16px hsl(28 28 25 / 0.06), 0 4px 8px hsl(28 28 25 / 0.04); } .ds-btn-pill:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring, #496458); } .ds-btn-pill-arrow { transition: transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-pill:hover .ds-btn-pill-arrow { transform: translateX(3px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary/tertiary action — transparent with a hairline border, charcoal ink text. Hover fills subtle.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 40px; padding: 0 1rem; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #1c1c19); font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid var(--border, #c2c8c3); border-radius: 0.3rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, #f0ede9); border-color: var(--primary, #496458); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ring, #496458); }

components.name: Paper Card
components.description: The default container for grouped content — white on cream, hairline border, soft warm shadow, lifts on hover.
components.html:
Italian Game

A classical open game starting 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4.
components.css: .ds-paper-card { background: var(--card, #ffffff); color: var(--card-foreground, #1c1c19); border: 1px solid var(--border, #c2c8c3); border-radius: 0.55rem; padding: 1.5rem; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px hsl(28 28 25 / 0.06), 0 1px 2px hsl(28 28 25 / 0.04); transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-paper-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 8px hsl(28 28 25 / 0.06), 0 2px 4px hsl(28 28 25 / 0.04); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-paper-card-title { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-family: "Newsreader", ui-serif, Georgia, serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-paper-card-body { margin: 0; font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--muted-foreground, #424844); }

components.name: Featured Card
components.description: The one emphasized card in a grid — sage-mist ground, sage border, generous padding. For 'start here' or featured game.

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Default form field — cream ground, 2px input border, sage focus with a soft halo. Errors shift to destructive.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background: var(--background, #fcf9f4); color: var(--foreground, #1c1c19); font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; border: 2px solid var(--input, #e5e2dd); border-radius: 0.8rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #424844); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--primary, #496458); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px hsl(153 16% 35% / 0.1); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--destructive, #ba1a1a); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px hsl(0 75% 42% / 0.1); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Button
components.description: Parchment-sidebar nav item — transparent at rest, sage-mist fill on hover/active. Sentence-case sans, not uppercase.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; background: transparent; color: var(--sidebar-foreground, #1c1c19); font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0.3rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--sidebar-accent, #a7c4b5); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground, #385246); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: var(--sidebar-accent, #a7c4b5); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground, #385246); } .ds-nav-icon { display: inline-flex; width: 1.25rem; justify-content: center; opacity: 0.8; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped tag — sage-mist ground for neutral labels, terracotta-blush for warnings. Uppercase tracked sans.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 24px; padding: 0 0.75rem; background: var(--primary-container, #a7c4b5); color: var(--primary-container-foreground, #385246); font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-chip-warning { background: var(--tertiary-container, #f8a8ab); color: var(--tertiary-container-foreground, #753b3e); }

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Modal — cream surface, hairline border, xl warm shadow, serif title. Centered, fades+zooms in.

components.css: .ds-dialog { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 50; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-dialog-overlay { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); animation: ds-fade 0.2s ease; } .ds-dialog-panel { position: relative; width: min(32rem, calc(100% - 2rem)); padding: 1.5rem; background: var(--background, #fcf9f4); border: 1px solid var(--border, #c2c8c3); border-radius: 0.8rem; box-shadow: 0 12px 24px hsl(28 28 25 / 0.08), 0 6px 12px hsl(28 28 25 / 0.04); animation: ds-zoom 0.2s ease; } .ds-dialog-title { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-family: "Newsreader", ui-serif, Georgia, serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--foreground, #1c1c19); } .ds-dialog-desc { margin: 0; font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--muted-foreground, #424844); } @keyframes ds-fade { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } } @keyframes ds-zoom { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.95); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }

narrative.overview:
Chess Coach is a quiet study tool, not a flashy game UI. It reads like a thoughtful chess journal — cream paper, sage-green ink, and the occasional terracotta note in the margin. The board is the centerpiece; the interface around it recedes. Every surface should feel like something you'd be comfortable sitting with for an hour of post-game review.

The palette is warm and restrained. Sage green (#496458) is the single committed accent — it carries every primary action, every success state, every active sidebar item, and the board's own move highlights. Terracotta (#8b4c50) is the marginalia: it marks warnings, tertiary emphasis, and the rare accent that isn't sage. The cream paper (#fcf9f4) and warm parchment sidebar (#eae5dc) hold everything. Nothing is pure white except cards sitting on the cream page; nothing is pure gray.

Typography pairs Newsreader (a warm transitional serif) for headlines with Hanken Grotesk (a friendly humanist sans) for body and labels. The serif headlines give the app its "worth reading closely" character; the sans body keeps dense move lists and PGN scannable. Decorative utilities — sketch-underline, sketch-border, paper-texture, organic-blob — are used sparingly to reinforce the hand-annotated feel. They are accent, never structure.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream paper background, never neutral gray; pure white only for elevated cards
Sage green as the single committed accent (primary, success, focus ring, board highlights)
Terracotta as marginalia only — warnings, tertiary emphasis, the rare non-sage accent
Newsreader serif headlines + Hanken Grotesk body; labels are uppercase, tracked, sans
Hand-annotated decorative utilities (sketch-*, paper-texture, organic-blob) as accent, not structure
Full dark mode where surfaces shift to charcoal and sage lightens to mist; same identity, inverted values
Restraint: the board commands attention, chrome recedes

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Sage is the primary accent for the entire system — buttons, focus, success, sidebar active, board highlights all draw from #496458. Do not introduce a second action hue. Terracotta is marginalia, not a competing action color.

rules.name: The Warm Paper Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds are warm (#fcf9f4 cream, #eae5dc parchment, #ffffff only for elevated cards). Never use neutral gray (neutral-*, gray-*, slate-* Tailwind defaults) — they break the paper metaphor.

rules.name: The Serif-For-Meaning Rule
rules.body: Newsreader (serif) is reserved for headlines and display. Body, labels, inputs, and tables are always Hanken Grotesk (sans). Do not set body copy in serif; do not set headlines in sans.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Label Rule
rules.body: Structural labels (eyebrows, nav, table headers, status tags) are uppercase, tracked 0.05em, weight 600, sans. Prose metadata stays sentence-case.

rules.name: The Warm-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow uses the warm charcoal ink color (hsl(28 28 25 / α)), never neutral black or default Tailwind shadow-* (which use gray).

rules.name: The Shadow-For-State Rule
rules.body: Cards rest at sm; they lift to md and translate y:-2px on hover. Shadows respond to interaction state. Dialogs and popovers are the only surfaces licensed for lg/xl at rest.

dos: Do use sage (#496458 / --primary) for every primary action, focus ring, success state, and active sidebar item.
Do keep backgrounds warm: cream paper (#fcf9f4), parchment sidebar (#eae5dc), pure white only for elevated cards.
Do pair Newsreader (serif) for headlines with Hanken Grotesk (sans) for body — and load the fonts (add a Google Fonts import or self-host).
Do use the warm shadow tokens (--shadow-*, all hsl(28 28 25 / α)); cards rest at sm, lift to md + translateY(-2px) on hover.
Do reserve uppercase tracked Label Md for structural labels; keep prose metadata sentence-case.
Do use decorative utilities (sketch-underline, paper-texture, organic-blob) sparingly — one or two per view.
Do let the chess board command its page; surrounding panels defer to it.
donts: Don't use Tailwind neutral-*, gray-*, or slate-* defaults for backgrounds, text, borders, or shadows — they are cold and break the warm-paper metaphor.
Don't introduce a second action hue. Terracotta is marginalia (warnings, tertiary emphasis), not a competing button color.
Don't set body copy in Newsreader or headlines in Hanken Grotesk. The serif/sans split is load-bearing.
Don't restyle the chessboard highlights to match the sage palette — the lichess-standard signals are recognition-critical.
Don't use shadow-xl/shadow-2xl at rest outside dialogs and popovers.
Don't apply paper-texture or organic-blob to working UI (forms, tables, controls) — hero/landing decoration only.
